div.head: Af 37.1
div.ab: Gif he hit buton his gewitnesse dó, gesylle se þe hyne to men feormige CXX scll' to wite: dæle he þæt hweðre, healf (þam) cyninge on ða scire ðe he ær folgode, (⁊) healf on ða ðe he (þonne) oncymð.
Gif he hit butan his gewitnesse do, geselle se þe hine to men feormie CXX scill. to wite: dæle he hwæðre ðæt, healf cyninge in ða scire ðe he ǽr folgode, healf in þa ðe he oncymð.

Si preter licentiam illius abscedat: qui eum in hominem susceperit, CXX solidos forisfacture reddat. Diuidatur tamen hoc, dimidium regi in comitatu quo ante seruiuit (incoluit), dimidium (uero) in eum quo uenerit.
Gif he hit butan his gewitnesse do, geselle se þe hine to men feormie CXX scill to wite: dæle he hwæðre ðæt, healf cyninge in ða scire ðe he ǽr folgode, healf in þa ðe he oncymð.

If he does it without his knowledge, let him who took him on as his man pay 120 shillings as fine: however, he should divide that, half to the [lord] in the shire he belonged to before and half to [the lord] in that [shire] where he has arrived.

If he does so without his cognisance, he who takes him into his emploment shall pay a fine of 120 shillings; but he shall divide the payment, [paying] half to the king in the district where the man has been residing, and half in that to which he has come.

Wenn er es ohne dessen Zeugniss thut, so zahle der [Herr], welcher ihn zum Manne aufnimmt, 120 Schill. zur Strafe: und zwar vertheile er dies dem Könige halb in die Grafschaft, welcher jener [Mann] bisher untergeben war, und halb in die, in welche derselbe [jetzt] hinkommt.

If he does it without his witness, let the [lord] who takes him on as his man pay 120 shillings as a fine: and indeed let him divide this for the king, half into the shire to which that [man] was hitherto subject, and half into the one into which he [now] comes.
